## Assessment
</br>

- The examinations will be *oral*.

  You will answer questions on topics covered in both lectures and tutorials in a discussion (40 minutes total). 
  <!-- present a (`R`-based) solution to a small case study assignment and  -->

- Tentative examination dates are January 29<sup>th</sup> and February 6<sup>th</sup>. Please see the [faculty page](https://www.wiwi.uni-due.de/studium/studienorganisation/pruefungen/pruefungstermine/) for updates.

- Please note that you **need** to register for the exams during the regular registration period via HISinOne.
